items.t: Annacis Island is an island in the Fraser River in the City of Delta, in the Highway 91 / Alex Fraser Bridge corridor; street access is by Derwent Way, Cliveden Avenue, Eaton Way and Audley Boulevard.

The current Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), treats Annacis Island as an industrial area; it is not one of the residential neighbourhoods named in the former North Delta Area Plan.
Where the condos are: there aren't any. No one lives on the island.
Nearby areas are Nordel and the rest of North Delta to the south across the Alex Fraser Bridge, New Westminster to the north, Richmond to the west, and the Tilbury industrial lands to the south-west.

Transit serves only the edge of the industrial area: route 340 runs from Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via Highway 91, the Alex Fraser Bridge and the Cliveden Interchange. There's no bus exchange on the island.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Annacis Island

items.t: Why there are no condos: Delta's Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 8400, 2024) names Annacis Island, River Road East, Tilbury Industrial Park and Roberts Bank as where Delta's industry is, and designates the island Industrial. Metro Vancouver's 2020 industrial lands inventory counted 1,527 hectares of industrial land in Delta.
The current OCP is the consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), and there is no separate Annacis Island area plan.

Strata law still applies — to industrial strata: where a strata plan is filed on the island, the Strata Property Act framework applies — owners own their strata lots and together own common property as a strata corporation — and on a resale the strata must provide a Form B Information Certificate.

Rental and age bylaws, for completeness: strata bans on long-term rentals have been void since November 24, 2022, and the only age bylaw a strata can have is 55+. Neither matters here, because there are no homes on the island's industrial land.

Taxes if you buy a home elsewhere: 5% GST applies to new homes only, not resales. The first-time buyers' GST rebate (law since March 13, 2026) covers all the GST on a new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out at $1.5 million, for agreements from March 20, 2025 to the end of 2030. The older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, up to $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

blocks.text: Good to know about Annacis Island condos

items.t: The auto terminal got bigger, not quieter: the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority's Annacis Auto Terminal Optimization Project consolidated the Annacis and Richmond auto terminals into the Annacis facility, enabling it to handle up to 480,000 vehicles annually — a 36% increase in capacity — with on-terminal works complete in early 2025.

Two approval regimes share one island: island parcels can be City-zoned industrial land or Port of Vancouver terminal land — the auto terminal at 820 Dock Road is designated "Port Terminal" under a port authority project permit (PER-21-019, issued September 26, 2022) — and the approval path differs by regime.

The region's wastewater plant is the other permanent neighbour: Metro Vancouver lists Annacis Island among its secondary wastewater treatment plants, serving the Fraser Sewerage Area — a permanent, high-activity industrial neighbour for any unit on the island.

Delta holds a disproportionate share of the region's industrial land: the OCP cites 1,527 hectares of industrially zoned and designated land in Delta, approximately 13% of Metro Vancouver's 2020 Regional Industrial Lands Inventory — policy pressure runs toward keeping islands like this industrial, not converting them to housing.

BCIT has a campus on the island — and still points students off-island for housing: BCIT's Annacis Island Campus page lists off-campus housing resources and hotels in surrounding areas (New Westminster, North Delta, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam) rather than any on-island accommodation.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Annacis Island
Streets, schools and transit near Annacis Island townhomes

items.t: The island is bounded by the Fraser River channels around it (the surrounding channels are called Annacis Channel and Annieville Channel); nearby areas are Nordel and the rest of North Delta to the south across the Alex Fraser Bridge, New Westminster to the north, Richmond to the west, and the Tilbury industrial lands to the south-west.
Where the townhouses are: there aren't any. There's no residential land on the island.

Transit serves only the edge of the industrial area: route 340 runs from Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via Scott Road, Highway 91, the Alex Fraser Bridge and the Cliveden Interchange. There's no bus exchange on the island.
North Delta is a SnapStats-covered community; Annacis Island simply has no residential row in it.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Annacis Island

items.t: Why there are no townhouse rules to apply on the island itself: the governing layer is industrial. The Delta OCP 2024 (Bylaw No. 8400, consolidated) designates Annacis Island industrial, and port-terminal parcels are also subject to Vancouver Fraser Port Authority permitting — the approval path for a parcel depends on which regime it sits under, and neither regime is residential townhouse development.

SSMUH does not create island housing: Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing Bylaws No. 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024, allow four units on residential properties (six within 400 m of frequent transit along Scott Road, in North Delta) — they apply to residential land, and Annacis Island has none.

If you look at a North Delta strata townhouse instead (the nearest homes), read the Form B: fees, amounts owing, approved levies, the contingency reserve balance, an insurance summary and the latest depreciation report. The strata must provide it within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page.

Depreciation reports and CRF (strata, general): since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, not deferrable by vote; since November 1, 2023, at least 10% of the annual operating budget must go to the contingency reserve fund.
Rental and age bylaws (strata, general): rental-restriction bylaws are void since November 24, 2022.

Fee-simple contrast (general): a fee-simple townhouse carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees — municipal rules and any registered covenants/HOA only. No fee-simple townhouse exists on Annacis Island because no townhouse of any tenure exists here.

blocks.text: Good to know about Annacis Island townhomes

items.t: The auto terminal got bigger, not smaller: the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority's Annacis Auto Terminal Optimization Project, in partnership with Wallenius Wilhelmsen, consolidated the Annacis and Richmond auto terminals into the Annacis facility and enabled it to handle up to 480,000 vehicles annually — a 36% increase in capacity — with on-terminal works complete in early 2025 per the port authority's timeline. That is the island's growth story, and it is industrial.

The region's sewage is treated here: Metro Vancouver's Annacis Island Wastewater Treatment Plant is a secondary treatment plant serving the Fraser Sewerage Area — a permanent, high-activity industrial neighbour that shapes truck traffic and odour expectations for nearby industrial units, and one more reason the island is not housing land.

Two governments touch an island parcel: island land can be City-zoned industrial land or Port of Vancouver terminal land (the auto terminal at 820 Dock Road is designated "Port Terminal" under a port authority permit, PER-21-019) — establish which regime a parcel sits under before drafting anything.

Delta's industrial base is regionally significant: 1,527 hectares of industrially zoned and designated land in Metro Vancouver's 2020 Regional Industrial Lands Inventory, approximately 13% of the region's inventory — Annacis Island is one of its four named homes (with River Road East, Tilbury Industrial Park and Roberts Bank).
There's no school catchment to check, because there are no homes and no public school on the island. Families searching "Annacis" are really looking at North Delta catchments.

The bridge is the whole commute case: access is Highway 91 via the Cliveden Interchange and the Alex Fraser Bridge, into the business park via Chester Road / Audley Boulevard and Cliveden Avenue — the same corridor route 340 uses.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Annacis Island
What trades here

items.t: What trades instead — industrial lots: freehold industrial lots and strata industrial units in the Annacis Business Park, plus port-terminal land at the Annacis Auto Terminal. Where a strata plan is filed, BC strata guidance applies — owners own their strata lots and together own common property as a strata corporation.
Fee-simple as the default land form: outside the strata industrial complexes, island land is fee-simple industrial land, held for logistics, warehousing, automotive-sector and service-industrial use.

Major industrial sites, not land for sale: the Annacis Auto Terminal (820 Dock Road) is a Port of Vancouver terminal designated "Port Terminal" and leased to WWL Vehicle Services Canada (Wallenius Wilhelmsen). Metro Vancouver's Annacis Island Wastewater Treatment Plant, one of its secondary treatment plants, is also on the island and serves the Fraser Sewerage Area.

Port project: the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority led the Annacis Auto Terminal Optimization Project in partnership with Wallenius Wilhelmsen, consolidating the Annacis and Richmond auto terminals into the Annacis facility and enabling it to handle up to 480,000 vehicles annually — a 36% increase in capacity; the port authority's timeline shows on-terminal works complete in early 2025. This is a completed port expansion on port land, not a lot offering.
I don't know of any Agricultural Land Reserve land on the island; it's industrial land.
Land assemblies, development sites and rezonings: I don't know of any on Annacis Island.
There are no market figures for Annacis Island: the board's Delta figures cover North Delta and its four residential areas only.

items.t: Annacis Island is an island in the Fraser River, in the City of Delta, in the Highway 91 / Alex Fraser Bridge corridor; the island is bounded by the Fraser River channels around it (Annacis Channel / Annieville Channel), and street access is by Derwent Way, Cliveden Avenue, Eaton Way and Audley Boulevard.
Nearby areas: Nordel and the rest of North Delta to the south across the Alex Fraser Bridge, New Westminster to the north, Richmond to the west, Tilbury industrial lands to the south-west.

Roads and commute: Highway 91 via the Cliveden Interchange and the Alex Fraser Bridge; access into Annacis Business Park is via Chester Road / Audley Boulevard and Cliveden Avenue; Highway 91 connects to the Highway 99 and Highway 17 routes.

Transit: route 340 runs from Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via Scott Road, 64 Avenue, Kittson Parkway, Highway 91, the Alex Fraser Bridge and the Cliveden Interchange, serving the edge of the Annacis Island industrial area. There's no bus exchange on the island.
Schools: there's no public school on Annacis Island, and no one lives there. Delta School District (SD37) catchments go by home address.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Annacis Island

items.t: Two approval regimes: island parcels can be City-zoned industrial land or Port of Vancouver terminal land (the auto terminal at 820 Dock Road is designated "Port Terminal" under a port authority permit), and the approval path differs — establish which regime the parcel sits under before drafting.

Flooding and dikes: the island is riverfront industrial land surrounded by channels of the Fraser River. The City of Delta is the diking authority and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection across the city, including dikes, seawalls and shoreline protection.

If you look at ALR land elsewhere in Delta: subdividing needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, homes can't be stratified, the main house can be up to 500 m² with a suite only inside it, and an additional home can be up to 90 m² (186 m² on parcels over 40 ha). For farm tax status, BC Assessment looks for farm income of $10,000 a year on under 0.8 ha, $2,500 on 0.8 to 4 ha, and $2,500 plus 5% of the value of land over 4 ha; applications are due by October 31.

If you buy a strata industrial unit, BC strata rules apply: check the Form B (fees, amounts owing, levies, contingency reserve balance and insurance; provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page). Stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years, at least 10% of the budget must go into the reserve, rental bans are void, and only 55+ age bylaws are valid. None of this allows anyone to live on industrial land.

items.t: I don't know of any parks, schools, shops or grocery stores on the island, which fits an island with no residents. The nearest hospital is Delta Hospital (5800 Mountain View Boulevard, Ladner), and the North Delta Public Health Unit is at 11245 84 Avenue.

faq.a: No. There are no houses, condos or townhomes on the island; the Official Community Plan designates it industrial.
faq.q: Are there any condos on Annacis Island at all?

faq.a: No. Those are strata industrial units (warehouse/industrial bays). Strata title is a form of ownership, not a residential use; the island's land use is industrial and port-terminal.
faq.q: I saw strata units for sale in the Annacis Business Park — are those condos I can live in?

faq.a: There's no public school on the island, and no one lives there. For homes elsewhere in Delta, catchments go by address; use the Delta School District's School Locator.
faq.q: Is there a school catchment for the island?

faq.a: Route 340 serves the edge of the industrial area via the Cliveden Interchange, between Scottsdale Exchange and 22nd Street Station. There's no bus exchange on the island.
faq.q: Can I get there by transit if I work on the island?

faq.a: No, there's nothing to buy. The island is industrial land under Delta's 2024 Official Community Plan, with no homes. The nearest townhouses are in North Delta, on the mainland south of the Alex Fraser Bridge.
faq.q: Can I buy a townhouse on Annacis Island?

faq.a: No. Those are strata industrial units — warehouse/industrial strata lots whose owners together own the common property as a strata corporation. Same Act, completely different product: no home, no residential use.
faq.q: But I saw strata units listed in the Annacis Business Park — aren't those townhouses?

faq.a: No. There are no homes on the island; Delta's Official Community Plan treats it as industrial land, home to the Annacis Business Park, the Port of Vancouver auto terminal and Metro Vancouver's wastewater treatment plant.
By Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge via the Cliveden Interchange, with park access via Chester Road / Audley Boulevard and Cliveden Avenue, as shown on the TransLink 340 route description.
faq.q: How is the island reached by road?

faq.a: It is the Port of Vancouver's vehicle terminal at 820 Dock Road on Annacis Island, operated by Wallenius Wilhelmsen; the port authority's optimization project consolidated the Annacis and Richmond auto terminals there, lifting capacity to 480,000 vehicles annually.
